correctness.rationale: Anchoring at a named sample point and ordering two independent uniform relative angles gives constant normalized density 2/π² in two angle coordinates. From Δ/(s−a_i), the sine law and half-angle identities, the exradius is 4 sin(A_i/2) cos(A_j/2) cos(A_k/2); pairwise ratios are tan(A_i/2)/tan(A_j/2), so the largest angle picks the largest exradius. With A largest, set u=B+C and v=B−C. Positivity and B,C≤A give |v|≤min(u,2π−3u), and the inverse Jacobian |∂(B,C)/∂(u,v)| is 1/2. The source's phrase naming the Jacobian direction is reversed, but the density 3/π² counting all three labels uses the correct inverse factor. Product-to-sum gives L=2cos(u/2)[cos(u/2)+cos(v/2)]. Its fixed-u sections give the asserted CDF with total mass one. Section minima decrease from 4 to 3/2 with equality at the equilateral point only; four is attained on the closed simplex only at the vertices. Fixed-u level sections have measure zero, proving no atoms by Fubini. Continuity on the connected open simplex and its positive density give strict increase between endpoints. At the minimum the linearization is sqrt(3) max_i δ_i, dominating a constant times the norm on the zero-sum plane; the uniform quadratic error and uniqueness localize the event to O(ε). Rescaling by ε gives a triangular limit of two-coordinate area 3/2, mapped affinely to the uniform Dirichlet simplex. At a corner the deficit is B²+BC+C²+O((B+C)^4); the event is bounded on the sqrt(ε) scale and the quadrant ellipse has area π/(3sqrt(3)), via the stated 60-degree sector map. The density and three corners give the upper coefficient, with constant labeled weights. For both tails the normalized indicators converge in L¹ on bounded rescaled domains, giving TV for the specified shape vectors. The scalar limits follow from 1−3 min_i D_i and squared radius respectively, in distribution. Independent split-interval quadrature using roots of the minimum and maximum section values gave F(2)=0.095449527761, F(3)=0.597104810021, F(3.8)=0.925231523525; the last displayed digits of the frozen approximations differ at about 10^−9, not in the exact CDF.
residual_risks: The TV assertions apply to the specified angle vector and labeled sector tuple, not to a joint-TV claim that appends the changing scalar excess/deficit as an additional exact coordinate. The endpoint proof is the sublevel-set analysis, not the quadrature or the supplied Monte Carlo diagnostics.
